query: SELECT nh.id, nh.email, nh.onboardingStatus, fs.formType, fs.status, JSON_EXTRACT(fs.formData, '$.firstName') as firstName, JSON_EXTRACT(fs.formData, '$.lastName') as lastName FROM new_hires nh LEFT JOIN form_submissions fs ON nh.id = fs.newHireId AND fs.formType = 'employment_application' ORDER BY nh.id;
